title: Atomic-Scale Insights into Cu Oxidation: Bridging the Pressure Gap
content: Understanding the oxidation mechanism at atomic scale is critical for rational corrosion protection and advanced manufacturing of functional oxides. Although extensive research has been conducted on the macroscopic growth of thermodynamically stable oxides using bulk oxidation methods, and the very early-stage oxygen interaction with metal surfaces using surface science techniques, the transition between these stages remains poorly understood. This transient stage – from oxide nucleation to the formation of thermodynamically stable oxide – is critical for controlling the location, structure and property of oxides.
